notes.title: 1.07 Patch Notes
notes.content:
[h1]Welcome to the 1.07 patch![/h1]

[b]This update is focused on fixing AI related issues.[/b]

•	AI cast-members flinch less easily when hit. Added difficulty scaling so the harder the level, the less likely to flinch.
•	Navigation improved overall for hired and enemy cast.
•	Cast are less likely to get stuck on angled floors in the Sewer.
•	Cast more consistently attack enemies, but a hired guy with a pipe will still be hesitant to attack a cast with a pistol or more powerful weapon.
•	Hired cast will immediately follow the player. No more having to specifically order a dude to follow after hiring.
•	Cast less likely to 'forget' what they are doing.
•	Scared cast will now check more frequently if they should stop hiding or trying to run through locked doors.
•	Territory is now consistently respected. Enemy will react to territory breaches like the original game.
•	Enemy cast will now remember hearing player gunshots for a short while. This vastly improves aggression/attack consistency from trigger spawned enemy.
•	SR1 guard now returns to the radio consistently compared with the original game. That is, in the original the guard will not go up the ramp and will stand below the radio on occasion, but mostly goes to the radio. This now occurs in Reloaded. It is likely to be a navigation data error when the guard fails to reach the radio and seems to be based on where the guard is on his route.

[b]Other changes:[/b]

•	Reduced blood spawning to reduce lag. The blood system will be getting a thorough going over in a later update.
•	Fixed RC Bar dude shirt skins
•	Fixed cast blood damage skins
•	Fixed secret detection code to account for faulty save/load system. All secrets should now be detectable.
•	Disabled some error checking for map loading. This will allow Ship Yards loads to work again.

Loading bugs will be fixed in the next patch.

notes.title: Kingpin: Reloaded 1.06 Update
notes.content:
[h1]Welcome to the Kingpin: Reloaded 1.06 update![/h1]

This update focuses on improving high-priority stability and progression issues. The team thanks you for your patience while we have been working on these improvements.

[b]Bug Fixes[/b]
1.	Fixed many crashes when starting the game.
2.	Failures that previously showed only a black screen or crashed to the desktop will now exit the game gracefully and show an error dialog with a descriptive code. These were mostly due to machines that did not reach the minimum specification.
3.	Fixed a crash when loading Steel Town saved games. This should also fix other unexpected or rare crashes when loading saved games in other hubs.
4.	Fixed a bug where it was impossible to get the Quest Master achievement.
5.	Fixed a bug where sky blockers would not render after loading a saved game, allowing structural geometry to be seen when it shouldn't.
6.	Fixed a bug where Chinese, Japanese, and Russian characters would not always display correctly when changing the language or would cause a crash.
7.	Fixed a bug in the Video menu when changing the FOV (field of view) mode.
8.	Fixed a bug where credits would only appear correctly at 1920 x 1080 resolution.

[b]Additional Changes[/b]
1.	Added a prompt to the Inventory and Notepad screens as a reminder to use the Inventory key to go back. This is important when in the Pawn-O-Matic as the Escape key is ignored.
2.	The change graphics mode key (default 9) is also ignored. These have been noted as bugs for attention in a later patch.

[b]We appreciate all the comments. We are planning additional fixes and improvements, and your continued feedback is incredibly helpful.[/b]

More is coming.

Thanks for playing!

notes.title: Following 3 years of radio silence, Kingpin remaster releases only to get slammed: 'Is it too late to hand this over to Nightdive?'
notes.content: I have strangely fond memories of Kingpin: Life of Crime, a 1999, vaguely dieselpunk-y FPS that I played far, far too young. It was ultraviolent, ultra-sweary, and had a light smattering of RPG elements that made it feel very novel to me back when I played it. I was pretty excited, then, when 3D Realms announced a remaster called Kingpin: Reloaded in 2020... Read more.

notes.title: Patch 1.01 and Known issues
notes.content:
We at 3D Realms and Slipgate Ironworks wanted to take a moment to address some of the reported issues related to Kingpin: Reloaded and share with you our plans to fix them. 

Below we’ve listed a variety of issues we’re aware players are experiencing with the game. In the meantime, we have already released the first patch that went live some hours ago and includes the below fixes:

[b]Patch 1.01[/b]
[list]
[*] Fixed crash / black screen with some languages.
[*] Fixed credits taking time to appear on some screen resolutions.
[*] Adjusted mouse input
[*] Fixed enhanced menu when using gamepad
[/list]

[b]Known Issues
[/b][list]
[*] Weapon view model sitting lower than in Life of Crime
[*] Ultrawide resolutions seem to be displaying at Vert- and are cutting off larger portions of the viewable space
[*] Models popping up in cutscenes shortly after loading an empty room
[*] Look of the blood effects in the game, difficulties gibbing enemies/corpses, and having trouble telling the difference between the various blood settings in the menu. 
[*] Explosion from explosive barrels is too large and fills the entire screen
[*] Blood decals are remaining after loading. If you die, when you reload, the blood decals from before are still present. 
[*] Shotgun pump sound not registering
[*] SSAO affecting performance
[*] Stuttering in game
[*] Rats, enemies, and teammates getting stuck and spinning in circles
[*] FOV changes cutting off weapon model
[*] Turning off bloom not working on certain light sources
[*] Vertical & Horizontal Mouse Sensitivity issues
[*] Long load times
[/list]

Watch for patches in the coming weeks as we work to address these issues and other player feedback as soon as we can. 

Thank you again for your patience, and all the feedback on the game you’ve shared with us over Steam, social media, and Discord. We are sorry for that and our team is working hard on fixing them and improving the overall quality of the game

notes.title: Kingpin: Reloaded Launch
notes.content:
[i]Kingpin: Reloaded[/i], the remastered, enhanced version of the classic criminal-themed first-person shooter, makes its long-awaited return to a life of crime on PC via Steam today thanks to developer Slipgate Ironworks and publishers 3D Realms and Interplay. Dish out revenge as a thug hellbent on taking down the Kingpin!

Featuring tons of quality of life improvements, enhanced visuals, and handcrafted up-scaled textures, [i]Kingpin: Reloaded[/i] is the definitive experience for both fans of the original game and newcomers alike.

Tune in to [url=https://www.twitch.tv/3drealms]3D Realms Live![/url] at 7pm Central European time today to check it out!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36614256/fe35da2e93cbbd7107a15e404f7efcb9d034ca34.jpg[/img]

[b]Notes/FAQ [/b]

- The game will launch at $19.99 with a 25% discount, 30% off for those who already own [i]Kingpin: Life of Crime[/i]. 

-  Supported languages: English, French, Italian, German, Spanish, Japanese, Polish, Portuguese (Brazil), Russian, Simplified Chinese

- Does it work on Steamdeck? Yes, we have tested it and it works. We are still awaiting the official checkmark :)

- The original [i]Cypress Hill[/i] soundtrack is included as well as the CD versions of each song

- Added Secret Mode: Unlocked when completing the game on Hard or Real. The new mode is called Hardcore Mode where you can play the game without any HUD or inventory.

- Quest Journal: To help you remember who you're working for and what you're doing in between dodging bullets

notes.title: Kingpin: Reloaded is OUT NOW!
notes.content:
[i]Kingpin: Reloaded[/i], the remastered version of the classic criminal-themed first-person shooter, makes its long-awaited return to a life of crime today! Dish out revenge as a thug hellbent on taking down the Kingpin.

Featuring tons of quality of life improvements, enhanced visuals, new quests system, and handcrafted up-scaled textures, Kingpin: Reloaded is the definitive experience for both fans of the original game and newcomers alike.

Check out the launch trailer here!
[previewyoutube=dBjyy9QK74A;full][/previewyoutube]

Tune in to [url=https://www.twitch.tv/3drealms]3D Realms Live![/url] at 7pm Central European time today to check it out!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36614256/fe35da2e93cbbd7107a15e404f7efcb9d034ca34.jpg[/img]

Those of you who have been following the project since it was announced may already know that it has been quite a journey to get it done and the team behind it has made a tremendous effort to bring this project to completion! They had to face several technical challenges (the source code of the original IP had been lost, which meant that they had to write a new engine- combining Unity and the original game- in order to reverse engineer and interpret the entirety of “Life of Crime”) and also make some sacrifices to what was initially planned. But despite the difficulties, we didn't want to disappoint you, and decided no matter the cost that we must keep our promise.

We hope you will all enjoy the game, whether you are an old fan of the original IP and want to revisit your childhood memories by playing it on modern day machines, or a younger fan who didn't have the chance to play it when it came out in 1999.

[h3][b]What’s new in Kingpin: Reloaded vs. the original Kingpin: Life of Crime?[/b][/h3]

[b]- Added Secret Mode:[/b] Unlocked when completing the game on Hard or Real. The new mode is called Hardcore Mode where you can play the game without any HUD or inventory.

[b]- New Quest Journal:[/b] Added a new interface to help you keep track of who you're working for and what you're doing in between dodging bullets

[b]- Controller Support:[/b] Controller support, complete with auto-aim is featured for those who want to give the keyboard and mouse a rest

[b]- New Menus and UI:[/b] Better readability and interactivity indicators. We’re also pretty fond of the new inventory screen.

[b]- New Weapon and Dialogue Wheels:[/b] In addition to the above-outlined improvements to UI, we’ve also included weapon and dialogue wheels. This impact will be better appreciated for players using a controller, but the utility is present for keyboard and mouse as well.


[h3][b]Important notes/FAQ [/b][/h3]
[b]- How much does the game cost?[/b]
The game's price is $19.99 with a 25% launch discount during the first week (each copy comes with a copy of the original “Kingpin: Life of Crime”). There is also a 30% discount for those who already own the original.

[b]- Supported languages?[/b]
English, French, Italian, German, Spanish, Japanese, Polish, Portuguese (Brazil), Russian, Simplified Chinese

[b]- Does it work on Steam Deck?[/b]
We have tested it on our machines and it works, however we are still awaiting the official checkmark :)

[b]- How about consoles?[/b]
Our priority has been on releasing the game on PC right now. We'll have an update regarding consoles after that.

[b]- How about Multiplayer?[/b]
Players will be able to experience Kingpin Multiplayer through the original 1999 Life of Crime version. We realize that this is unideal for everyone involved, but our team did their best to make it work. Unfortunately, due to the technical challenges that are mentioned above, it wasn’t possible to happen before the launch. We might revisit this post-launch, but we don’t want to make any promises as it’s been a big challenge for the team to complete.

[b]- Will it launch on GoG?[/b]
Yes! As soon as we get approval.

[b]- Does Kingpin: Reloaded have the original music?[/b]
The original Cypress Hill soundtrack is included as well as the CD versions of each song

[b]- Why do the rats no longer hurt the player?[/b]
We made an executive decision that the game is more fun without the rats being so annoying. Kingpin is about gangbanging, not pest control.

[b]- Available for Mac / Linux?[/b]
We'd like to support both Mac and Linux, but that will depend on various technical aspects. We don't want to promise anything yet, but it's something we will check post launch

[b]- Has Kingpin: Reloaded been censored in any way?[/b]
Nothing is censored! Kingpin: Reloaded has all the cursing and violence from the original game

notes.title: After 3 years of silence, Kingpin Reloaded resurfaces with a new trailer and a December release date
notes.content: I was very pleasantly surprised when 3D Realms announced in January 2020 that a remaster of the 1999 FPS Kingpin: Life of Crime was in the works. It's not an especially well-known shooter, but I have fond memories of its extreme violence, grimy ambience, endless profanity, and overall sense of silliness—it's a game that aspired to be as over-the-top as possible on all fronts. Alas, the release was delayed in November of that same year, after which it fell off the radar completely... Read more.

notes.title: Kingpin: Reloaded Delayed until 2021
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36614256/f26a14d3acb2f3dec1af0612297b2f6a387003ba.png[/img]

Hey everyone!

I want to give you all an update on KP Reloaded, and why it's taking so long.
Early this year we revealed the game, with the goal of releasing the game this summer.

However, some major changes have happened during development, which is why we've decided to delay the game.

We decided earlier this year to change our approach to the Remaster. As you all know, the original source code for Kingpin no longer exists, so our original plan was to "Recreate" the game in a modern engine (The same approach Nightdive uses for their KexEngine games).

However, during this, we quickly realized that in order to get the game to Feel 100% like the original (Including the fantastic path-finding for AI, etc.), a better approach would be to reverse engineer the original game and engine completely, essentially re-creating the missing sources from scratch.

We've been hard at work on this for the majority of 2020, and are finally at a stage where we're almost done.

Alongside the programming side of things, we're also close to being done with re-creating every texture in the game from scratch, in high-resolution. No AI Upscaling here! 

In January we're entering the next stage of development - Putting it all together, which is at the point where we'll finally be able to share more videos, gameplay, screenshots, and open up the closed-beta.


Stay tuned everyone! Kingpin is coming!


Sincerely,
The Kingpin: Reloaded Team!

notes.title: Kingpin Reloaded Update
notes.content:
First we want to thank everyone for hanging in there! 
It's been some crazy months since we first revealed Kingpin Reloaded, and things are going quite well!


You might wonder: Where are all the news? How about some updates huh? Are we going to see anything from Kingpin Reloaded at Realms Deep? The short answer is YES!

Right after we revealed the game at PAX South earlier this year, we realized that we had to drastically change the technical approach to this game, in order for us to make sure the Reloaded version would feel as authentic as possible.

As many of you already know, the source code to Kingpin: Life of Crime, no longer exists. That left us with two options:

1. Use another engine and write interpreters to use the Kingpin: Life of Crime data. (This was the approach the picked).

2. Completely re-engineer the source code from scratch (A huge undertaking, but it would result in a much more "Accurate" port).

We went with the first approach, which was the basis of the reveal back in January.
However, we soon realized that in order to replicate many of the key aspects of Kingpin - especially the AI - going for the second approach would be a better solution.

So we started over and dived into completely re-engineering and porting KP, using Unity as a backend.


We're happy to announce that we're ALMOST there. Unfortunately, in order to show gameplay, we'll have to pretty much be done with the entire port.

This should be done before the end of the year, at which point we'll have brand new screenshots, footage and a gameplay reveal of the game.

Until then, we want to give you a little sneak peek - We're pretty much done re-doing all of the artwork from the original game, and we want to give you a small taste of the visual differences between the original and Kingpin Reloaded.

We've assembled a Comparison Video below, which we hope you'll enjoy for the time being!

[previewyoutube=UhaNOpoOKVY;full][/previewyoutube]

TL;DR - We're close to the finishing line, and we have much more to show later this year!
